skill.description: Apple HIG guidance for designing input methods across Apple platforms, including gestures, Apple Pencil, keyboards, pointers, remotes, controllers, focus, spatial input, and sensors.

content.value_statement: Apple apps need consistent input behavior across devices. This skill gives HIG guidance for gestures, keyboards, pointers, Pencil, visionOS, tvOS, and sensors.
actual_capabilities: Summarizes HIG input guidance for touch, pointer, keyboard, Pencil, remotes, game controllers, and sensors.
Recommends platform-appropriate gesture and shortcut behavior for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, and visionOS.
Provides accessibility-aware guidance for alternate inputs, focus behavior, and discoverable controls.
Points to local reference files for detailed Apple HIG sections.
Helps compare input methods and choose fallbacks for hardware-specific features.
limitations: It is design guidance, not executable implementation code.
It does not replace current Apple documentation or App Store review guidance.
It cannot test gestures on physical devices.
Reference content may become dated when Apple updates the HIG.

use_cases.title: Plan iPad Input Support
use_cases.description: Map touch, Pencil, keyboard, and pointer behavior before a feature enters design review.

use_cases.title: Review Spatial Interaction Models
use_cases.description: Check visionOS gaze, pinch, hand, and focus patterns against Apple platform expectations.

use_cases.title: Specify Remote Navigation
use_cases.description: Define predictable focus movement and remote actions for tvOS media or game interfaces.

prompt_templates.title: Get Input Guidance
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for one Apple platform.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to recommend input methods for my iPad app. Include gestures, keyboard support, pointer behavior, and accessibility alternatives.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Gesture Spec
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a gesture specification for this feature. Separate standard gestures, custom gestures, fallback inputs, and conflicts with system gestures.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Cross-Platform Inputs
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this interaction design for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, and visionOS. Identify platform-specific input changes and missing alternatives.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve Interaction Conflicts
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert analysis for complex hardware and spatial input.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this complex input design across visionOS, tvOS, and iPadOS. Identify conflicts with system gestures, focus behavior, and hardware constraints.

output_examples.input: How should a drawing app support Apple Pencil and touch on iPad?
output: Use Apple Pencil for drawing, markup, hover previews, and precise selection.
Keep finger gestures available for scrolling, zooming, panning, and direct manipulation.
Support Scribble in text fields and provide undo for destructive Pencil actions.

output_examples.input: Review our tvOS home screen navigation.
output: Make every interactive item focusable with a clear focus indicator.
Use predictable directional movement and avoid surprise focus changes.
Map remote presses, taps, and back actions to simple, reversible outcomes.

output_examples.input: What input alternatives should a visionOS immersive tool offer?
output: Support look-and-pinch for core actions with generous target sizes.
Avoid sustained gaze as an activation requirement.
Provide keyboard, controller, or accessible alternatives for repeated tasks.

best_practices: Start with standard Apple gestures and controls before adding custom interactions.
Provide more than one input path for important tasks.
Validate each recommendation against the target platform and hardware.
anti_patterns: Do not override system gestures for routine app actions.
Do not make hardware-specific input the only way to complete a task.
Do not hide custom gestures without visible hints or coaching.

faq.question: Which platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, and visionOS input guidance.

faq.question: Can it write implementation code?
faq.answer: It focuses on design guidance and interaction specifications, not production code.

faq.question: Does it include Apple Pencil guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers Pencil drawing, hover, squeeze, double tap, and Scribble behavior.

faq.question: Can it help with accessibility?
faq.answer: Yes. It highlights alternate inputs, focus behavior, and avoiding single-input requirements.

faq.question: Does it need network access?
faq.answer: No. The skill uses local Markdown references and does not need live web access.

faq.question: How should teams use it during review?
faq.answer: Use it to compare designs against Apple input expectations before prototyping or handoff.
